att_finish_two_foot_balance.instruction: When traffic is near, land on two feet before your finish so you can absorb contact and choose the angle.
att_finish_two_foot_balance.title: Finish with two-foot balance

att_offball_show_target_window.instruction: Move into a passing lane where the passer can see your hands and deliver on time.
att_offball_show_target_window.title: Show a target window

att_onball_protect_outside_hip.instruction: On a live dribble, keep the ball outside your hip and use your body between the defender and the ball.
att_onball_protect_outside_hip.title: Protect the outside hip

comm_screen_call_early.instruction: Say the screen direction before contact so the defense has time to adjust.
comm_screen_call_early.title: Call the screen early

decision_extra_pass_window.instruction: After catching an advantage, check the next pass before the defense recovers.
decision_extra_pass_window.title: Find the extra-pass window

def_offball_see_player_ball.instruction: When guarding away from the ball, open your stance enough to track both your matchup and the ball.
def_offball_see_player_ball.title: See player and ball

def_onball_contain_first_step.instruction: Start chest to the ball and slide to cut off the first driving lane before reaching.
def_onball_contain_first_step.title: Contain the first step

def_rebound_find_player_first.instruction: When the shot goes up, locate your opponent before tracking the ball.
def_rebound_find_player_first.title: Find your player first

habits_confidence_next_play_reset.instruction: After a mistake, name the next job and move into it before replaying the last action.
habits_confidence_next_play_reset.title: Reset for the next play

habits_prep_one_cue.instruction: Before a session, choose one cue you can repeat on the floor instead of tracking everything.
habits_prep_one_cue.title: Carry one court focus

transition_run_immediately.instruction: When possession changes, react immediately. Sprint into your transition responsibility before becoming a spectator.
transition_run_immediately.title: Run first

transition_stop_ball_early.instruction: On defensive transition, the nearest player slows the ball before it reaches the paint, while teammates match up behind.
transition_stop_ball_early.title: Stop the ball early
